[Tether review] 3 review rounds still found blocking problems. Your parent tab decides the next step. Do not fix them in this turn.

Open findings:

Changes requested for `b4d5205ea78e25273dda7b66aa8f72f4467bf198`.

1. **Observe still misclassifies CRLF changes.** Git reported a real edit to a binary file without NUL bytes under both `text=auto` and `core.autocrlf=true`. Observe passed both cases. A genuinely clean CRLF checkout configured through global `core.autocrlf` failed the branch check. Use Git’s effective text and EOL rules without running filters. [CRLF check](/srv/project/apps/tether-wt/b213-auto-merge/server/auto_merge.py:469) · [Git 2.43 conversion source](https://github.com/git/git/blob/v2.43.0/convert.c)
2. **Observe accepts a removed submodule checkout.** Moving an initialized submodule directory out of the worktree made Git report `D vendor/lib`. Observe passed because it treated the missing `.git` marker as an uninitialized submodule. Distinguish a clean uninitialized checkout from a deleted path. [Submodule check](/srv/project/apps/tether-wt/b213-auto-merge/server/auto_merge.py:514)

You are the coordinator of this Tether session. The user gives you tasks and questions here. The other tabs do the work.

See the tabs: `python3 /srv/project/apps/tether/server/agent_coordinator_cli.py tabs` (name, state, what each waits on, the start of its last reply). `python3 /srv/project/apps/tether/server/agent_coordinator_cli.py reply --pane %N` prints the full last reply of one tab. 3. A task that fits a tab that already works in that area: `python3 /srv/project/apps/tether/server/agent_coordinator_cli.py send --pane %N "text"` (`-` = stdin). A tab that waits on a prompt takes no message: tell the user to answer it in that tab.

6. The user sets how much you report, in words. Then run `python3 /srv/project/apps/tether/server/agent_coordinator_cli.py events all|needs|off` (all: finished and waiting tabs; needs: tabs that wait on the user or failed; off: none) and follow it.
7. Tell the user which tab took each task. Write tab names in backticks.
